socratic_questions.question: 你认为一个人的穿着风格能反映他的性格吗？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 可以从颜色选择、搭配方式、场合适应性等角度讨论。

sentences: The house was built in a traditional Chinese ___.

image_prompts: A group of students sitting around a table discussing a poster for their science project.
An architect looking at a blueprint of a building project in an office.
words.image_desc_en: Students discussing a science project poster around a table.
words.image_desc_cn: 学生们围坐在桌子旁讨论科学项目的海报。
words.usage: n. 项目，课题；v. 投射，规划
words.collocations: school project, project manager, project plan, group project

examples.en: Our science project on recycling won the first prize.
examples.cn: 我们关于回收利用的科学课题获得了一等奖。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to present our project to the class next week.
examples.cn: 老师要求我们下周向全班展示我们的项目。

socratic_questions.question: 进行小组项目时，如果组员意见不合，应该怎样解决才能保证项目顺利进行？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 可以讨论分工、投票、或者寻求老师建议。

sentences: The students are working on a history ___ about ancient Rome.

image_prompts: A student smiling while receiving a compliment from the teacher in class.
A family having fun playing board games together in a living room.
words.image_desc_en: A student smiling after receiving a compliment from the teacher.
words.image_desc_cn: 一名学生因受到老师表扬而开心地笑。
words.collocations: with pleasure, my pleasure, take pleasure in, pleasure trip

examples.en: It is a great pleasure to have you as my desk mate this semester.
examples.cn: 这学期有你做我的同桌真是件开心的事。

examples.en: He takes great pleasure in reading books under the tree in the park.
examples.cn: 他非常享受在公园的树下读书的乐趣。

socratic_questions.question: 你认为'快乐'和' Pleasure '有什么区别？请用生活中的例子说明。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 快乐可能更持久，pleasure侧重短暂的满足感，比如吃冰淇淋。

sentences: —Thank you for your help! —___.

image_prompts: A student struggling to close the zipper of her school bag full of books.
A tailor repairing a zipper on a pair of jeans in a small shop.

words.image_desc_cn: 一名学生费力地拉上装满书的书包拉链。
words.usage: n. 拉链；v. 拉上拉链
words.collocations: zip up, zipper pull, jacket zipper, zipper repair

examples.en: Be careful not to catch your shirt in the zipper of your backpack.
examples.cn: 小心别让衬衫夹到背包的拉链里。

examples.en: My jacket has a broken zipper, so I need to buy a new one.
examples.cn: 我的夹克拉链坏了，所以我得买件新的。

socratic_questions.question: 拉链的发明给我们的生活带来了哪些便利？如果没有拉链，你会用什么替代？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 可以想到纽扣、系带、魔术贴等，并比较优缺点。

sentences: He quickly ___ his jacket before running out into the rain.

image_prompts: A student checking off items on a daily to-do list in a bright classroom.
A cup of coffee and a newspaper on a breakfast table in the morning sunlight.
words.image_desc_en: A student checking off items on a daily to-do list in a bright classroom.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个学生在明亮的教室里核对每日待办事项清单。
words.collocations: daily routine, daily life, daily newspaper, daily exercise

examples.en: I always brush my teeth and wash my face as part of my daily routine.
examples.cn: 作为日常习惯的一部分，我总是刷牙洗脸。

examples.en: Reading the daily newspaper helps me stay informed about world events.
examples.cn: 阅读日报能让我了解世界大事。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么说“daily”这个词能帮助我们更好地安排时间？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想每天固定做的事情，比如写日记、锻炼，它们能让我们更有规律。

sentences: She keeps a ___ journal to write down her thoughts every day.

image_prompts: A student looking at a computer screen showing a school website with a calendar.
A woman typing on a laptop, with a 'Your Website Here' sign in the background.
words.image_desc_en: A student looking at a computer screen showing a school website with a calendar.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个学生看着电脑屏幕，屏幕上显示着带有日历的学校网站。
words.collocations: official website, website design, visit a website, website address
words.preposition_combos: on the website, of the website

examples.en: Our school has a website where we can check homework and announcements.
examples.cn: 我们学校有一个网站，可以查看作业和通知。

examples.en: He created his own website to share his travel photos with friends.
examples.cn: 他创建了自己的网站，和朋友分享旅行照片。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么我们需要验证一个网站的可信度？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑信息来源的可靠性，比如官网或知名新闻网站。

sentences: You can find more information about the competition on the school’s ___.

image_prompts: An old photograph of Marie Curie in a laboratory with beakers and equipment.
A group of students building a robot with a 'Pioneer Robotics Club' banner.
words.image_desc_en: An old photograph of Marie Curie in a laboratory with beakers and equipment.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张玛丽·居里在实验室里拿着烧杯和设备的旧照片。
words.collocations: pioneer in, pioneer of, young pioneer, space pioneer

examples.en: Marie Curie was a pioneer in the study of radioactivity.
examples.cn: 玛丽·居里是放射性研究的先驱。

examples.en: Our school's science club is a pioneer in using 3D printers for learning.
examples.cn: 我们学校的科学俱乐部是使用3D打印机学习的先锋。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么说袁隆平是农业领域的先驱？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想他对杂交水稻的贡献，帮助了很多人。

sentences: Thomas Edison was a ___ in the field of electricity.

image_prompts: A person writing a grocery list on a notepad with a pencil.
A student checking off completed tasks on a whiteboard to-do list.
words.image_desc_en: A person writing a grocery list on a notepad with a pencil.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个人在笔记本上用铅笔写购物清单。
words.usage: v. / n. 列表；列清单；名单
words.collocations: shopping list, to-do list, list of, make a list

examples.en: Mom asked me to make a shopping list before going to the supermarket.
examples.cn: 妈妈让我去超市前列个购物单。

examples.en: The teacher listed all the homework assignments on the whiteboard.
examples.cn: 老师把所有的作业都列在了白板上。

socratic_questions.question: 列清单有什么好处？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑如何避免忘记事情，比如购物或学习任务。

sentences: Please ___ the items you need for the project.

image_prompts: Two students chatting in the hallway, one says 'By the way, don't mention our plan to others.'
A teacher mentioning exam dates on the blackboard while students take notes.
words.image_desc_en: Two students chatting in the hallway, one says 'By the way, don't mention our plan to others.'
words.image_desc_cn: 两个学生在走廊聊天，其中一个说：“顺便说一下，不要向别人提起我们的计划。”
words.collocations: mention that, mention to, mention in, as mentioned

examples.en: Don't forget to mention your favorite book in the book report.
examples.cn: 别忘了在读书报告中提到你最喜欢的书。

examples.en: He mentioned that the school trip would be next Friday.
examples.cn: 他提到学校旅行在下周五。

socratic_questions.question: 在什么情况下我们不应该在公开场合提到别人的秘密？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑尊重隐私，保护他人的感受。

sentences: Did she ___ anything about the party?

image_prompts: A student searching under a desk suddenly finds a shiny coin.
A chemist in a lab accidentally knocks over a beaker and a new color appears.
words.image_desc_en: A student searching under a desk finds a coin by accident.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个学生在桌子下翻找，意外发现了一枚硬币。
words.usage: 短语，表示偶然发生，非故意
words.collocations: find by accident, discover by accident, meet by accident, happen by accident

examples.en: I found my lost pen by accident under the desk.
examples.cn: 我无意中在桌子下找到了丢失的钢笔。

examples.en: The scientist discovered the new material by accident while doing another experiment.
examples.cn: 这位科学家在做另一个实验时偶然发现了这种新材料。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你不小心打碎了花瓶，是‘by accident’还是‘on purpose’？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想‘意外’和‘故意’的区别。

sentences: He met his old friend ___ on the street yesterday.

image_prompts: A clock showing 11:58 PM, a family walking into a house.
A student finishing a long essay, only a few words left.
words.image_desc_en: A clock shows nearly midnight as a family arrives home.
words.image_desc_cn: 时钟显示将近午夜，一家人到家了。
words.collocations: nearly finished, nearly everyone, nearly died, nearly always

examples.en: I nearly missed the school bus this morning.
examples.cn: 我今天早上差点没赶上校车。

examples.en: The project is nearly complete; we just need to add the final touches.
examples.cn: 项目几乎完成了，我们只需要添加最后的修饰。

socratic_questions.question: 如果考试你得了89分，能说‘nearly 90’吗？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想‘nearly’和‘almost’的区别，以及89离90有多近。

sentences: It was ___ midnight when we finally arrived home.

image_prompts: A pot of water with bubbles rising to the surface on a stove.
A person's face turning red with fury, hands clenched.
words.image_desc_en: A pot of water on a stove bubbles vigorously as it boils.
words.image_desc_cn: 炉子上一锅水剧烈冒泡，沸腾了。
words.collocations: boil water, boil eggs, boil over, boil with anger
words.preposition_combos: boil with, boil over, boil down to

examples.en: Please boil some water to make tea for the guests.
examples.cn: 请烧些水给客人泡茶。

examples.en: He was boiling with anger when he heard the news, but he stayed calm.
examples.cn: 他听到消息时怒火中烧，但还是保持了冷静。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么我们说‘水沸腾了’时用‘boil’，而不用‘cook’？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想‘boil’和‘cook’的动作对象有什么不同。

sentences: The milk began to ___ over the pot if you don't watch it.

image_prompts: A girl leaning over a flower bed, eyes closed, inhaling deeply.
A kitchen with smoke rising from a toaster, a person rushing in.
words.image_desc_en: A girl smells flowers in a garden with a peaceful expression.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个女孩在花园里闻花香，表情平和。
words.usage: n. 气味；v. 闻到，发出气味
words.collocations: smell good, smell like, sense of smell, smell something burning

examples.en: The flowers in the garden smell wonderful in spring.
examples.cn: 春天花园里的花闻起来很香。

examples.en: I can smell something burning in the kitchen; maybe the toast is done.
examples.cn: 我闻到厨房里有东西烧焦了，可能面包烤好了。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你说‘The room smells of smoke’，这里的‘of’能不能换成‘like’？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 注意‘smell of’表示直接的气味来源，而‘smell like’表示类似。

sentences: The soup ___ delicious; I can't wait to taste it.

image_prompts: A stained glass window depicting a haloed figure with a dove.
An elderly woman feeding stray cats in the rain, smiling.
words.image_desc_en: A stained glass window shows a saint with a halo and a dove.
words.image_desc_cn: 彩色玻璃窗上画着一位带光环和鸽子的圣人。
words.collocations: patron saint, saint's day, saint like, Saint Valentine

examples.en: Saint Patrick is the patron saint of Ireland, celebrated on March 17.
examples.cn: 圣帕特里克是爱尔兰的主保圣人，在3月17日庆祝。

examples.en: She is so kind and generous; her neighbors call her a saint.
examples.cn: 她非常善良慷慨，邻居们称她为圣人。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么人们称非常善良的人为‘a saint’，而不是其他头衔？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想‘saint’这个词在宗教和日常用语中的比喻意义。

sentences: Many churches are named after a ___ who is important to the local community.

image_prompts: A school playground with students and a banner saying 'Sports Day' under a sunny sky.

words.image_desc_en: A school sports day scene with students racing on the track.
words.image_desc_cn: 学校运动会的场景，学生们在跑道上赛跑。
words.usage: 短语动词，意为“发生；出现”，常指有计划或安排的事件发生。
words.collocations: take place in, take place on, take place at, take place during

examples.en: The school sports meeting will take place next Friday.
examples.cn: 校运动会将于下周五举行。

examples.en: The story took place in a small village many years ago.
examples.cn: 这个故事发生在多年前的一个小村庄里。

socratic_questions.question: “take place”和“happen”都可以表示“发生”，它们在使用上有什么主要区别？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 注意“take place”常暗示计划或安排，“happen”则多表示偶然发生。

sentences: The concert will ___ at the city hall tonight.

image_prompts: A student scratching his head in front of a blackboard full of math formulas.
A person holding a magnifying glass over a newspaper headline with a question mark overlay.
words.image_desc_en: A puzzled student looking at a complicated math problem on the blackboard.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个困惑的学生看着黑板上复杂的数学题。
words.usage: n. / v. 名词时意为“疑惑；疑问”；动词时意为“怀疑；不信任”。
words.collocations: have doubt, no doubt, doubt about, doubt that

examples.en: I have a doubt about the answer to this question.
examples.cn: 我对这个问题的答案有疑惑。

examples.en: There is no doubt that hard work leads to success.
examples.cn: 毫无疑问，努力工作带来成功。

socratic_questions.question: 当我们想说“我怀疑他的诚实”时，名词和动词形式分别怎么表达？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 用名词可以说“I have doubt about his honesty”，用动词可以说“I doubt his honesty”。

sentences: She looked at the strange object with a sense of ___.

image_prompts: A student receiving a first-place trophy with a confident smile.
A person nodding firmly with a thumbs up as the sun rises behind them.
words.image_desc_en: A proud student holding a gold medal on a podium.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个自豪的学生站在领奖台上举着金牌。
words.usage: 短语副词，意为“毫无疑问；的确”，用于强调肯定语气。
words.collocations: without any doubt, without doubt, without a doubt

examples.en: He is without doubt the best player on our team.
examples.cn: 他毫无疑问是我们队里最好的球员。

examples.en: Without doubt, this is the most interesting book I've ever read.
examples.cn: 毫无疑问，这是我读过的最有趣的书。

socratic_questions.question: 什么情况下用“without doubt”比用“no doubt”更合适？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: “without doubt”语气更强，常用于肯定事实；“no doubt”有时带推测意味。

sentences: She is, ___, the most hardworking student in our class.

image_prompts: A kitchen with an open fridge showing colorful fruits and vegetables inside.
A child reaching into an open fridge to get a bottle of juice.
words.image_desc_en: A kitchen fridge opened, revealing neatly arranged food inside.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个打开的厨房冰箱，里面整齐地摆放着食物。

words.collocations: open the fridge, fridge door, fridge magnet, put in the fridge

examples.cn: 冰箱里有一些牛奶和鸡蛋。

examples.cn: 请把这些剩菜放进冰箱保鲜。

words.image_desc_cn: 一本双语词典摊在桌子上，旁边有笔和纸。

examples.cn: 你能把这首英文诗翻译成中文吗？

words.collocations: lock the door, lock the bike, lock away, lock in

examples.en: Please lock the door before leaving.

examples.cn: 我忘记锁自行车了，结果被偷了。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么我们要锁门？

sentences: Don't forget to ___ your suitcase before you go to bed.

examples.en: We had an earthquake drill at school yesterday.

socratic_questions.question: 地震时我们应该做什么？

examples.cn: 他突如其来的决定让所有人都很惊讶。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么突然的变化有时让人害怕？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 因为我们没有准备，感到未知。

sentences: The car came to a ___ stop to avoid hitting a dog.

image_prompts: A balloon popping all of a sudden.
A cat jumping all of a sudden from a box.
words.image_desc_en: A balloon bursting unexpectedly.
words.image_desc_cn: 气球突然爆裂。
words.collocations: appear all of a sudden, happen all of a sudden, stop all of a sudden

examples.en: All of a sudden, the lights went out.
examples.cn: 突然，灯灭了。

examples.en: All of a sudden, I heard someone calling my name.
examples.cn: 突然，我听到有人叫我的名字。

socratic_questions.question: 用“突然”和“all of a sudden”有什么不同？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 两者意思相同，但“all of a sudden”更口语化，常用于故事叙述。

sentences: ___, the baby started crying.

image_prompts: A plate of biscuits with a cup of tea.
A child dipping a biscuit into milk.
words.image_desc_en: A pile of round biscuits on a blue plate.
words.image_desc_cn: 蓝色盘子上的一堆圆形饼干。
words.collocations: eat a biscuit, chocolate biscuit, butter biscuit, biscuit tin

examples.en: I had a biscuit with my milk this morning.
examples.cn: 今天早上我配着牛奶吃了一块饼干。

examples.en: She packed some biscuits in her lunchbox.
examples.cn: 她在午餐盒里装了一些饼干。

socratic_questions.question: 饼干和面包有什么不同？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 饼干较硬、脆，而面包较软。

sentences: Would you like a ___ with your tea?

image_prompts: A child takes a cookie from a jar on the kitchen counter.
A tray of freshly baked golden cookies cooling on a rack.
words.image_desc_en: A child takes a cookie from a jar. / Freshly baked cookies on a baking tray.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个孩子从饼干罐里拿出一块饼干。/ 烤盘上刚烤好的曲奇饼干。
words.usage: n. (可数名词) 曲奇饼干
words.collocations: chocolate cookie, homemade cookie, bake cookies, cookie jar

examples.en: Mom baked a batch of chocolate chip cookies for us after school.
examples.cn: 妈妈放学后为我们烤了一盘巧克力曲奇。

examples.en: Let's share these cookies with our friends during the break.
examples.cn: 我们休息时把这些饼干分给朋友们吃吧。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么曲奇饼干通常是甜的？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想曲奇的主要原料，比如糖、黄油和巧克力。

sentences: Yesterday I ate a very delicious chocolate ___.

image_prompts: Students playing various instruments in a music classroom.
A microscope and other scientific instruments on a lab table.
words.image_desc_en: Students playing various instruments in a music class. / A microscope on a lab table.
words.image_desc_cn: 学生们在音乐课上演奏各种乐器。/ 实验室桌子上的显微镜。
words.usage: n. (可数名词) 器械；仪器；工具；乐器
words.collocations: musical instrument, scientific instrument, play an instrument, instrument panel

examples.en: In music class, each student chooses a musical instrument to learn.
examples.cn: 在音乐课上，每个学生选择一种乐器来学习。

examples.en: Scientists use precise instruments to measure temperature in experiments.
examples.cn: 科学家在实验中使用精密仪器测量温度。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么乐器被称为 'instrument' 而不是 'tool'？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想工具和乐器的目的不同：工具用来完成任务，乐器用来创造音乐。

sentences: My brother can play two musical ______, like guitar and piano.

image_prompts: A plate of golden fried chicken with a crispy, bubbly skin.
A slice of freshly toasted bread with a crisp brown edge.
words.image_desc_en: A plate of golden fried chicken with crispy skin. / A freshly toasted slice of bread.
words.image_desc_cn: 一盘外皮酥脆的金黄色炸鸡。/ 一片刚烤好的面包片。
words.collocations: crispy bacon, crispy skin, crispy fried, crispy texture

examples.en: The potato chips are so crispy that they make a loud crunch.
examples.cn: 薯片非常酥脆，咬起来嘎嘣响。

examples.en: In autumn, walking on crispy leaves feels like stepping on crackers.
examples.cn: 秋天踩在酥脆的落叶上，感觉像踩在饼干上。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么我们喜欢酥脆的食物？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想口感带来的愉悦和听觉上的享受。

sentences: I love this ______ fried chicken with a crunchy outer skin.

image_prompts: A cut lemon showing its juicy, yellow inside.
A person making a funny face while biting into a sour plum.
words.image_desc_en: A cut lemon showing its juicy inside. / A person making a face while eating a sour plum.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个切开的柠檬，露出多汁的内部。/ 一个人吃酸梅时皱眉的表情。
words.collocations: sour taste, sour milk, sour fruit, go sour

examples.en: This lemon is too sour to eat alone, but it tastes great in lemonade.
examples.cn: 这个柠檬太酸了不能单吃，但做柠檬水很好喝。

examples.en: If you leave milk out too long, it will go sour.
examples.cn: 牛奶如果放太久就会变酸。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么有些食物故意做成酸的，比如酸菜？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想保存食物的方法和增添风味的作用。

sentences: She doesn't like fruits that are ______, like lemons or gooseberries.

image_prompts: A student picking up a backpack that is not his own.
A person pouring salt into a coffee cup, mistaking it for sugar.
words.image_desc_en: A student picking up the wrong backpack. / A person pouring salt into coffee, mistaking it for sugar.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个学生拿错了别人的书包。/ 一个人把盐当成糖倒进咖啡里。
words.usage: 短语 (副词性) 错误地；无意中
words.collocations: take by mistake, delete by mistake, pick up by mistake, send by mistake

examples.en: I picked up someone else's schoolbag by mistake after P.E. class.
examples.cn: 体育课后我错拿了别人的书包。

examples.en: He deleted an important file by mistake and couldn't find it later.
examples.cn: 他误删了一个重要文件，后来找不到了。

socratic_questions.question: 如何避免在考试中因粗心而犯错误？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想检查答案和放慢速度的方法。

sentences: He took his deskmate's pencil case ______.

image_prompts: A friendly shop assistant smiling at a woman customer who is holding a dress.
A customer paying for groceries at a supermarket checkout counter.
words.image_desc_en: A female customer browsing clothes in a boutique with a salesperson nearby.
words.image_desc_cn: 一位女顾客在精品店浏览衣服，旁边有店员。
words.collocations: loyal customer, regular customer, customer service, potential customer

examples.en: The store treats every customer with kindness.
examples.cn: 这家商店对每一位顾客都很友善。

examples.en: As a loyal customer, you can get a special discount.
examples.cn: 作为忠实顾客，你可以获得特别折扣。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么商家要重视每一位顾客？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 顾客是商家的收入来源和口碑传播者。

sentences: The shop assistant is helping a ___ choose a jacket.

image_prompts: A Canadian flag waving in front of a snowy mountain.
Two Canadian students chatting in a cozy coffee shop with maple leaf decorations.
words.image_desc_en: A close-up of a red and white Canadian flag against a blue sky.
words.image_desc_cn: 一面红白相间的加拿大国旗在蓝天中飘扬。
words.usage: adj. / n. 加拿大的；加拿大人
words.collocations: Canadian dollars, Canadian culture, Canadian citizens, Canadian flag

examples.en: My pen pal is a Canadian student from Toronto.
examples.cn: 我的笔友是一位来自多伦多的加拿大学生。

examples.en: Canada has a rich Canadian culture with many traditions.
examples.cn: 加拿大拥有丰富的加拿大文化，包含许多传统。

socratic_questions.question: 如果想去加拿大留学，你需要了解哪些加拿大文化？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 可以从节日、饮食习惯、社交礼仪等角度思考。

sentences: He bought a ___ sweater as a souvenir from his trip.

image_prompts: A teacher dividing students into teams by pointing to different sides of the classroom.
A group of friends dividing a large pizza with a cutter.
words.image_desc_en: A person using a knife to divide a chocolate cake into equal slices.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个人用刀将巧克力蛋糕分成均匀的几块。
words.collocations: divide equally, divide into groups, divide the work, divide among

examples.en: The teacher divided the class into four groups for the project.
examples.cn: 老师把全班分成四个小组来完成这个项目。

examples.en: They decided to divide the pizza equally among themselves.
examples.cn: 他们决定把披萨平均分给自己。

socratic_questions.question: 分配任务时，为什么要把工作分成若干部分？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这样能让每个人发挥特长，提高工作效率。

sentences: Please ___ the cake into eight pieces so everyone can have one.

image_prompts: A teacher dividing a whiteboard into sections for different subjects.
A map of the world divided into time zones with colored lines.
words.image_desc_en: A student drawing a line to divide a notebook page into two columns.
words.image_desc_cn: 一名学生画线将笔记本页面分成两栏。
words.collocations: divide the class into, divide the cake into, divide the work into, divide the land into

examples.en: The teacher divided the students into small groups.
examples.cn: 老师把学生分成小组。

examples.en: They divided the large room into two smaller offices.
examples.cn: 他们把这个大房间隔成两个小办公室。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么科学家要把地球分为不同的时区？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 为了方便全球统一时间管理和协调活动。

sentences: We need to ___ the tasks ___ several parts to finish on time.

image_prompts: A student writing down the purpose of an experiment in a notebook.
A group of business people discussing the purpose of their new strategy in a meeting.
words.image_desc_en: A close-up of a journal page with 'Purpose: to understand photosynthesis' written in neat handwriting.
words.image_desc_cn: 日记本页面上写着“目的：理解光合作用”整洁字迹的特写。
words.collocations: main purpose, specific purpose, for the purpose of, serve a purpose

examples.en: The purpose of this English test is to check our progress.
examples.cn: 这次英语测试的目的是检查我们的进步。

examples.en: He borrowed the money for the purpose of buying a new laptop.
examples.cn: 他借钱是为了买一台新笔记本电脑。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么做任何事情之前要先明确目的？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 目的就像指南针，指引我们前进的方向，避免浪费时间。

sentences: The main ___ of this meeting is to discuss the new project.

image_prompts: A wicker basket filled with fresh fruits sits on a picnic table under a tree.
A basketball player jumps high to shoot the ball into the basket hoop.
words.image_desc_en: A wicker basket full of fruits on a picnic table.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个装满水果的柳条篮子放在野餐桌上。
words.collocations: shopping basket, wastepaper basket, fruit basket, basketball hoop
words.preposition_combos: in a basket, into a basket

examples.en: Please put the waste paper into the basket next to the desk.
examples.cn: 请把废纸扔到桌子旁边的废纸篓里。

examples.en: We carried a picnic basket full of sandwiches and fruit to the park.
examples.cn: 我们提着一个装满三明治和水果的野餐篮去公园。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么篮球运动员要把球投进一个网状的篮筐，而不是一个实心的桶？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想篮球的起源——最初是用桃篮和梯子，后来才演变成现在的样子。

sentences: I put the apples in a ___.

image_prompts: The Olympic flag with five colorful rings flutters in the wind above a stadium.
Athletes sprint toward the finish line on a track, with the Olympic stadium in the background.
words.image_desc_en: The Olympic flag with five rings flying over a stadium.
words.image_desc_cn: 奥运五环旗在体育场上空飘扬。
words.usage: n. 奥林匹克运动会（专有名词，常加定冠词）
words.collocations: hold the Olympics, win a medal at the Olympics, participate in the Olympics, host the Olympics
words.preposition_combos: in the Olympics, at the Olympics

examples.en: Our school sports meeting is like a mini Olympics, with many events.
examples.cn: 我们学校的运动会就像一个小奥运会，有很多项目。

examples.en: The Olympics bring together athletes from all over the world every four years.
examples.cn: 奥运会每四年把全世界的运动员聚集在一起。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么奥运五环用五种颜色？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 五环代表五大洲，颜色取自各国国旗常见的颜色，象征团结。

sentences: The ___ are held every four years in different cities.

image_prompts: A little boy looks up at his father with admiration, his eyes shining.
Students surround a famous scientist, listening carefully with respect.
words.image_desc_en: A little boy looking up at his father with admiration.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个小男孩抬头看着他的父亲，眼神充满敬佩。
words.usage: phr. v. 钦佩；仰慕（通常接人作宾语）
words.collocations: look up to someone, look up to a role model, look up to elders

examples.en: I really look up to my English teacher because she always encourages us.
examples.cn: 我非常钦佩我的英语老师，因为她总是鼓励我们。

examples.en: Many young people look up to scientists and want to be like them.
examples.cn: 很多年轻人仰慕科学家，想要成为他们那样的人。

socratic_questions.question: 什么样的人值得你发自内心地钦佩？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想那些有爱心、有勇气或坚持梦想的人，他们的行为给了你什么启发？

sentences: We should always ___ our parents and learn from their experience.

image_prompts: A firefighter carries a child out of a burning building, while bystanders clap.
A superhero in a cape stands on a skyscraper, looking over the city.
words.image_desc_en: A firefighter rescuing a child from a fire, people applauding.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个消防员从火场中救出小孩，周围的人鼓掌。
words.collocations: national hero, action hero, become a hero, hero worship

examples.en: He became a hero after saving a child from the river.
examples.cn: 他因为从河里救出一个孩子而成了英雄。

examples.en: My grandfather is a hero in my heart because of his kindness.
examples.cn: 我的祖父因为他的善良是我心中的英雄。

socratic_questions.question: 你认为什么样的行为可以称得上英雄行为？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想那些为他人牺牲、勇敢面对危险或坚持正义的人。

sentences: Superman is a famous ___ in comics and movies.
